In 4-dimensional quantum field theory, every closed loop momentum integral typically produces a factor

  (1/16π²) = 1/(4π)² .

Hence an amplitude with L loops carries a factor (1/(4π)²)^L = 1/(4π)^{2L}.

The size estimate on the note contains the factor 1/(4π)^6.  Setting 2L = 6 gives

  L = 6 / 2 = 3 .

Therefore the original diagram must have contained three loops.

Answer: B
